title: Sprzedawczyni
description: Realistyczny warzywniak na początku lat 90. Sprzedawczyni za ladą patrzy z góry ponad okularami na dwóch chłopaków poza kadrem. Lekko przerysowana aparycja i surowe spojrzenie, bez kreskówkowej stylizacji. Kamera z wysokości niższego klienta. Przebitka 34 klatki pomiędzy wejściem do sklepu a zakupem oranżady.

prompts.image: Use case: historical-scene, photorealistic-natural. Create ONE widescreen 16:9 1920x1080 live-action film still for an early-1990s Polish small-town greengrocer. Image 1 is an archival equipment reference ONLY: the real old mechanical shop scale and practical simple shelves, not the clerk identity, not black-and-white, not the alcohol-heavy stock. Image 2 is our exact continuity reference for the brown woodgrain laminate countertop, its subtle wear and photographic color. Image 3 is our shop continuity: modest green-painted interior cabinetry, jars, vegetables and soft overcast daylight through the storefront; do NOT include the boys or exterior view. Shot: medium close view of ONE fictional imposing shopwoman behind the counter, approximately 55, stocky, strong broad face, tight auburn perm, large unfashionable brown glasses slightly down her nose, floral nylon apron over a muted burgundy blouse. Slightly grotesque casting but completely believable human anatomy, candid realism, skin pores and natural age lines, not cartoon or a fancy costume. Her raised chin and lowered eyes convey dry unimpressed authority: she looks DOWN OVER HER GLASSES toward the two shorter teenage customers offscreen just below the camera, gaze slightly camera-left, not into lens. Camera from customer side at young teenager eye height about 1.35m, modest low angle, natural 50mm lens. Face large and crisp, waist-up body, brown counter across lower fifth, one relaxed hand rests on counter and the other remains below it. Mechanical cream enamel scale sits at far right edge partly cropped and does not cover her face. Behind her are humble worn shelves with pickled jars, paper bags, and wooden crates of cabbages onions potatoes and apples, period stock not supermarket abundance. Everyday working shop, maintained but worn, no theatrical dirt. Muted green and cream walls, grey daylight from front-left, slight fluorescent overhead fill, restrained film grain, same photographic realism as images 2 and 3. Only one person. No modern checkout, barcode scanner, payment terminal, plastic fruit stickers, modern packaging, speech bubble, caption, watermark or stylized illustration. Leave gaze/eyebrows ready for one brief downward glance in animation.
prompts.animation: 0.0–0.8s: The shopwoman holds her chin slightly raised and lowers only her eyes over her glasses toward the short customers just below and slightly left of camera. 0.8–1.4s: Her gaze drops a little farther toward their coins on the customer side of the counter, with one restrained eyebrow lift. 1.4–3.0s: She holds the dry, unimpressed expression with natural breathing. Camera: rigid locked medium close-up at customer eye height. @Image1 fixes only the existing brown laminate countertop and shop light; do not add its hand or packets. Preserve the Start Frame woman, glasses, perm, apron, scale, shelves and all lettering. Her resting hand stays still. No speaking, broad gestures, new people, extra fingers, facial morphing, cuts or zoom.
